_note: Tiering is deliberately simple and explainable. Every threshold here is a judgement call, not a standard.

scoring._why: v3.1 has the widest NVD coverage today, so it is the most consistent basis. v4.0 and v3.1 base scores are NOT comparable — across the FIRST example set the delta runs -2.9 to +1.8, and 3 of 11 CVEs change tier on version alone under this policy (4 of 11 under a CVSS-only model). Set this to v4.0 only when your whole inventory has v4.0 coverage.

thresholds._why_percentile: EPSS raw probability is heavily skewed — the median CVE sits near 0.0004. Percentile is the more stable trigger.
